deals.name: Magnolia's On The Bay
deals.deal: Bay Bar happy hour: Tue-Fri 2-5pm and Sat-Sun 12-5pm at the bar and Bay View Garden (except holidays and special events). Featured martinis $10, house wine $5 off, call cocktails/mimosas/Bloody Marys/sangria $4 off, craft drafts $3 off. Bay bites: oysters $15.90/dozen, shrimp cocktail $11.90, $10 off listed sushi rolls.

deals.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
deals.deal: Weekly specials Oct 5-11, 2026: lunch soup and short-rib cheddar sandwich half $19.90, kale and beet salad $18.90; dinner maple-bacon pork ribeye $24.90, Calabrian chili ravioli $24.90, seafood lasagna $34.90, sage-seared triggerfish $36.90, lobster and scallop pastry puff $45.90. Order online for takeout. Site also advertises HH 11am-6pm daily.

deals.name: SandBar Tiki & Grille
deals.deal: Drink menu advertises daily happy hour at the bar only, 11am-6pm, on domestic drafts, well spirits, and house wine. House wines by the glass $9. Mix-and-match bucket of 5 for $25. Takeout listed.

deals.name: Calico Jack's
deals.deal: Happy Hour Mon-Fri noon-5pm and Happier Hour Mon-Fri 5-7pm with all beers and cocktails 2 for 1. Sunday noon-4pm draft beer and Bloody Mary specials. Free pool all day Wednesday. Cash only.
